reference: reference.jpg (the lamp screen: third panel, and the cropped first panel)
unit: percent of the frame's width, measured from the frame's top-left corner; viewport 1440 wide, overview page, default variant

title.note: title sits in the poured tab at the top centre of the frame

sidebar.note: slim icon rail, full height of the content

ring.note: the large outer circle, centred in the frame

lamp.note: the lamp shade (dome only, not the cord): large, pale grey, centred in the ring

object.note: bell-shaped shade: thin neck at the top, flaring to a wide rim; satin silver-grey with a visible light-to-dark gradient

readout.note: small light '12/7' under the lamp, not a headline

controls.note: light label, intensity slider, schedule, donut: one column left of the ring, not overlapping it

donut.note: orange ring donut with an inset centre

room.note: room buttons sit on the ring's left arc

view-ellipse.note: dashed '360° view' ellipse directly under the lamp

requirements.text: All seven sidebar icons open their own working page
Room buttons on the arc switch the room: readout, intensity, schedule and donut change
The lamp in lamp.js stays as built by the maintainer
